The Chance roll is dangerous because it can advance me to Boardwalk or trigger costly repairs.

The mortgaged properties are worth only about $250 in face value, so the strategic premium is enormous. I am worried the AI might reject an offer that looks like overpay.

I will offer all three mortgaged properties to p4. Keeping only two would leave me with a weaker package, and p4 might later trade for the orange set. The bankruptcy threat is too urgent to take that risk.

I dismissed a fantasy trade with p2 for Park Place. I will submit the offer to p4. I am now weighing whether to lower the price to $250 to maximize acceptance probability before I feel pressure to end my turn.
